run.hint: This runs the original Python code in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server. The first start downloads the Python runtime (about 13 MB).

state.unsupported: Your browser blocks the feature this terminal needs. Try reloading the page or a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.

how.inBrowser: The Python files are copied from my GitHub repo at a fixed commit and served by this site. When you press Run, your browser downloads Pyodide (CPython compiled to WebAssembly) and runs the program in a Web Worker, a separate thread, so the page stays responsive. The terminal is xterm.js. When the program calls input(), the worker sleeps on shared memory until you press Enter.
how.static: This project runs on its own, outside this site. The overview shows its README from GitHub.
how.runner: Runs go into a job queue in Postgres. A Python worker picks them up, runs them with a timeout and writes the result back; the page watches the job live.
how.bot: The bot runs on a small server and writes a heartbeat to the database after every check. This page only reads it.
